records.domainAndConvergence: For u in[0,m], g(u)=sqrt(C+u) is increasing and maps the interval into itself. Since a1>a0, monotonicity of g gives increasing bounded iterates. Continuity gives L²-L-C=0 and positivity chooses m.
records.optionsVisibleRoute: Let B=sqrt(C)+1. B²-(C+B)=sqrt(C)>0, so[0,B] is invariant with a uniform strict upper bound g(B)<B. The limit exceeds a1=sqrt(C). The open unit interval(sqrt(C),sqrt(C)+1) contains exactly the integer m, which is the only displayed survivor.
